# The goal corpus (#873)

Every mesh here is generated by this repo — `scripts/gen-goal-fixtures.mts`, except the STEP pair
below, which `scripts/gen-step-fixture.mts` writes — so nothing third-party is checked in.
Regenerate only when a shape itself changes:

```sh
npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/gen-goal-fixtures.mts
npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.scripts.json scripts/gen-step-fixture.mts
```

The acceptance tests read the FILES, never regenerate them; a change to a fixture is a change to
the baseline numbers the worker tier pins.

| File | What it is | Why it is in the corpus |
|---|---|---|
| `relief-plate.stl` / `.obj` | 40 × 30 × 4 mm plate with a 20 × 10 mm raised boss (a relief), flat back | The relief case: a flat back means the top setup legitimately reaches part of the surface, and what remains is one flat face. It must get NO flip proposal (the noise rule). |
| `figure.stl` | A stylised animal: body, four legs, head, and a tail that overhangs the bed. ~34 mm tall | The maintainer's case: an underside, undercuts and a shadow band. A top-only plan looks finished and is not; the plan must reach ≥95 % (#872) — on this shape the top and the flip leave surfaces shadowed under the body, so it takes a third side. |
| `figure-inches.obj` | The same figure, its numbers divided by 25.4, with `# units: in` | The wrong-units import: the file says inches, and the unit sentence must say so. |
| `near-sphere.stl` / `.3mf` | A ⌀30 mm sphere | A smooth closed surface whose whole lower half faces away — the coverage measure's arithmetic is countable, and the 3MF door gets exercised. |
| `deep-pocket.stl` | 40 × 40 × 20 mm block with a 6 × 6 mm pocket 15 mm deep | Deeper than a small end mill's reach: the reach check and the top-band option. |
| `thin-wall-box.stl` | 40 × 40 × 20 mm box, 1 mm walls and floor | Thin walls: the raster's tolerance, and a surface with almost as much inside as outside. |
| `tilted-bar.stl` | A 30 × 8 × 20 mm slab standing on its end | A part that does not lie flat: "Lay it flat" must propose the turn (20 mm deep → 8). |
| `open-shell.stl` | A box with no lid — five faces | A non-manifold mesh, built by hand on purpose (no solid kernel produces it). |
| `step-accuracy.step` / `step-accuracy-fine.3mf` | One 60 × 40 × 12 mm solid (plate, 2 mm corner fillet, 3 mm hole, 2 mm-high R20 cap) saved twice: a hand-authored AP214 B-rep and a fine Manifold 3MF | #873: the kernel's STEP tessellation is pinned at every curved feature to ≤ 0.05 mm, and both files must generate and sweep the same goal program. |

Sizes are stated by the meshes' own bounding boxes; the worker tier asserts the import's size,
format, unit sentence and lay-flat answer against them.
